title: Failed to install gflags

labels.name: category:vcpkg-bug
labels.description: The issue is with the vcpkg system (including helper scripts in `scripts/cmake/`)

body:
ENV：
1. vcpkg version bd7cd7f56d5d9fdfeb1f57810a2ea77bf4d7e31a
1. Windows 10 professional, simplified Chinese locale
2. cmake: 3.9.1 c:/Program Files/CMake/
3. git:  2.14.1.windows.1 
4. Installed VS
	- Microsoft Visual Studio Community 2017 15.2 (26430.16) Release
	- Microsoft Visual Studio Community 2015 Version 14.0.25431.01 Update 3
5. I have successfully installed `libevent:x86-windows` and `libevent:x86-windows`, but failed to install gflags.
